free_tier.stated: GPU cloud credits, Token Factory tokens and Tavily credits. The page states 'The exact amount is determined individually based on each proposal' and states no ceiling. Eligibility is a closed list of four roles, all academic: 'Postgraduate students conducting academic research', 'PhD students and postdoctoral researchers', 'Faculty members from accredited academic institutions', 'Researchers from accredited academic institutions or non-profit research organizations'.

evidence.proved: the 'Who can apply' list names exactly four roles, every one tied to an accredited academic or non-profit institution; 'The exact amount is determined individually based on each proposal'; page 200

'We are now accepting applications for the 2026-2027 academic year', 'Nebius Academy will review applications throughout summer 2026', 'Successful applicants will be notified by email in late Q3 to early Q4 2026' - a seasonal cycle, not a rolling one

notes: Recorded because the amount is unbounded and the program is live, which makes it a magnet for the next session. The absence of a published ceiling is the trap: 'determined individually' means the record has no number to compare against any other entry, and the four-role list has no independent lane. A co-marketing obligation is attached ('being open to publicly acknowledging Nebius support'), which is a publishing condition rather than a compute one. Nothing here is a reason to reject it as a product; the door is the finding.
